INSERT INTO download_history (
                        gid,
                        user_id,
                        kind,
						category,
                        source_uri,
                        status,
						options,
                        created_at,
                        updated_at
                        )
                    SELECT
						?,
						user_id,
						kind,
						category,
						source_uri,
						'active',
						options,
						CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
						CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    FROM download_history
                    WHERE gid = ?
                    ON CONFLICT(gid) DO NOTHING
